% Fixture: failures/err-missing-input
%
% Purpose: verify that \input referencing a non-existent file is reported.
%
% Expected maketex behaviour:
%   - Engine: pdflatex -halt-on-error
%   - Exit: 1 (fatal error)
%   - No PDF produced
%
% Log errors (exact text):
%   ! LaTeX Error: File `this-file-does-not-exist.tex' not found.
%   ! Emergency stop.
%
% The error surfacing system should extract:
%   - type:    error
%   - file:    main.tex
%   - line:    16  (the \input line)
%   - message: File `this-file-does-not-exist.tex' not found.
%
% This is distinct from err-missing-package: the engine looks for a .tex
% file rather than a .sty file, and the \input command is the trigger.

\documentclass{article}

\begin{document}

This is real content before the error.

\input{this-file-does-not-exist}

This content is never reached.

\end{document}
